title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a plug-in meter measurement guide for Session 1
body:
## Problem
Section E suggests measuring an appliance with a meter, but there is no step-by-step guide with a safe checklist.

## Context
Students compare the label power with measured energy; safety and clear steps matter.

## Expected outcome
A short guide (text and a table template) for measuring one appliance for one hour with a plug-in meter, with safety notes.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Table template added
- [ ] Safety notes reviewed by a maintainer

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: time-of-use tariffs and load shifting
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's second milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask whether moving a heater to the night changes the bill.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-02/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a home battery
body:
## Problem
Session 3 has solar but no storage; the evening still comes from the grid.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the learner sets battery size and power limits and sees import, export and bill update.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint shown
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: animated day view with a Sankey diagram
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a day of load, solar and battery with a Sankey diagram; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Energy in equals energy out at every frame (1e-6 kWh)
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
